t_fft.why: x87 excess precision in four1's butterfly. The object narrows tempr/tempi to float mid-butterfly (fstps 0xc(%esp) at 0x537a0 and 0x537b4) because GCC 3.4.2 runs out of x87 registers; GCC 13 does not run out and keeps 80 bits, and neither a plain float assignment, an explicit (float) cast, nor a named double temporary moves it -- only volatile, which is a shim for GCC 13 alone and no longer in the source. `make period` passes all 155.
